activities.title: Surfing at Arugam Bay
activities.summary: Sri Lanka's best-known surf destination: a string of right-hand point breaks on the east coast, best from May to September.
activities.seasonNote: Opposite season to the south coast. Early mornings (about 5:30-9 am) are cleanest. Beginner-friendly spots exist (Baby Point, Elephant Rock, Peanut Farm inside), but coaching mostly targets improvers.

activities.title: Surfing and lessons: Weligama and the south coast
activities.summary: A wide, sandy bay with gentle waves that suits first lessons; reef breaks nearby (Midigama, Hikkaduwa) for intermediates. Best November to April.
activities.seasonNote: October and early November are unpredictable; May to September is rough monsoon on this coast, though Weligama's sheltered bay can still give gentle beginner waves.

activities.title: Whale and dolphin watching from Mirissa
activities.summary: Boat trips from Mirissa harbour for blue whales, sperm whales and dolphins during the south-coast season, roughly November to April.
activities.seasonNote: Sources differ on the peak (December to March versus December to April). No operator can promise a sighting.
activities.responsibleTravelNote: No operator can promise a sighting. Choose operators that follow whale-watching rules and avoid swim-with-whale trips.

activities.title: Whale and dolphin watching from Trincomalee
activities.summary: The east-coast counterpart of Mirissa, running roughly May to September when the south coast is rough.
activities.seasonNote: Sources differ: some say May to August, the IWC handbook lists blue whales off Trincomalee from March to July. October is poor on both coasts.
activities.responsibleTravelNote: No operator can promise a sighting. Choose operators that follow whale-watching rules.

activities.title: Leopard safari in Yala National Park
activities.summary: Jeep safaris in a park with one of the world's highest leopard densities; also elephants, sloth bears and crocodiles. Best February to July.
activities.seasonNote: Block 1 usually closes from about mid-September to mid-October (dates set each year by the Department of Wildlife Conservation). Confirm before booking. Enter at gate opening to avoid jeep queues.
activities.responsibleTravelNote: Follow ranger and park rules; keep distance from animals.

activities.title: Safari in Wilpattu National Park
activities.summary: Sri Lanka's largest park: forest and natural lakes, far fewer jeeps than Yala. Leopards and sloth bears are possible but need patience.
activities.seasonNote: Palu fruiting around June and July is the best chance of sloth bears.

activities.title: Elephant safari in Udawalawe
activities.summary: Open grassland with a large resident elephant population; dependable sightings in any month and no annual closure reported.
activities.seasonNote: Sources disagree on the best months (February to July versus December to March). Treat it as a year-round park.

activities.title: The Gathering: elephants at Minneriya and Kaudulla
activities.summary: As reservoirs shrink, large herds feed on the exposed lake bed; one of Asia's great wildlife sights. Late-afternoon drives are best.
activities.seasonNote: Some sources start the season in June. Herds move between Minneriya, Kaudulla and Hurulu with water levels: book by where the elephants are, not the park name.

activities.title: Climb Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
activities.summary: An overnight climb of roughly 5,500 steps to a sacred summit for sunrise. The lit pilgrimage season runs from December to May.
activities.seasonNote: Season opens at the December Unduvap Poya and closes at the May Vesak Poya. Best on weekdays in January to March; avoid Poya nights, weekends and the April holidays. Outside the season the steps are unlit and a guide is advised.
activities.responsibleTravelNote: Sacred to Buddhists, Hindus, Muslims and Christians: dress modestly, remove shoes at the summit temple.

activities.title: Little Adam's Peak and Ella Rock
activities.summary: Two classic hill-country hikes: Little Adam's Peak is a short easy walk (about 1-2 hours return); Ella Rock is a longer, rougher climb (about 3-4.5 hours return).
activities.seasonNote: Clearest mornings are January to March; showers can occur year-round. Ella Rock is poorly signed: use a local guide, especially in the dark.

activities.title: Horton Plains and World's End
activities.summary: A loop of about 9.5 km across high plains to a cliff edge known as World's End.
activities.seasonNote: The park gate opens at 6 am; aim to reach World's End before about 9-9:30 am when mist usually closes in. Entry fees change: link to the official fee notice, do not store a price.

activities.title: Scuba diving: Hikkaduwa and Unawatuna
activities.summary: Reef, wreck and turtle dives on the south-west and south coast during the dry season, roughly October/November to April.
activities.seasonNote: Dive centres move to the east coast in the monsoon months (see Pigeon Island).
activities.responsibleTravelNote: Follow local marine-park rules; do not touch coral or wildlife.

activities.title: Snorkelling and diving at Pigeon Island, Trincomalee
activities.summary: Shallow coral reefs, blacktip reef sharks and turtles in a marine national park off Nilaveli; best in the east-coast season.
activities.seasonNote: Operators quote different start and end months (roughly mid-March to October). Pigeon Island is a marine national park with its own rules.
activities.responsibleTravelNote: Marine national park: follow ranger rules; do not touch coral or wildlife.

activities.title: Tea estates and factory visits
activities.summary: Working tea factories and estates around Nuwara Eliya (Pedro, Labookellie), Haputale (Lipton's Seat, Dambatenne) and the Ceylon Tea Museum in Kandy.
activities.seasonNote: Opening hours and fees not verified: check each estate before publishing.
activities.needsVerification: Season, opening hours and fees not verified. Central Province Tourism page timed out during research.

activities.title: Kitesurfing in Kalpitiya
activities.summary: Flat-water lagoon kitesurfing on the north-west coast with reliable summer winds.
activities.seasonNote: Season from operator and blog snippets only; not independently verified.
